sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了心思来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Relatively quiet, on the night of October 10, 1984, at Oli's Home Center, a one-stop hardware shop located in South Pasadena, California.
sentences.zh: 1984年10月10日的夜晚相对平静，地点位于加利福尼亚州南帕萨迪纳的一家一站式五金店——奥利家居中心。

sentences.en: Oli's store consisted of an 18,000-square-foot building situated in an outdoor shopping plaza on the corner of Fair Oaks Avenue and State Street.
sentences.zh: 奥利のお店占地1.8万平方英尺，位于费尔奥克斯大道与州街转角处的露天购物广场内。

sentences.en: The heavily trafficked intersection was in the northern neighbourhood of Raymond Hill,
sentences.zh: 这个车流量巨大的十字路口位于雷蒙德山北部社区，

sentences.en: a quiet suburb with panoramic views across Pasadena and nearby cities San Marino and Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 这是一个宁静的郊区，放眼望远，帕萨迪纳以及邻近的圣马力诺和洛杉矶市的景色尽收眼年底。

sentences.en: The store was usually busy, with a constant stream of customers shopping for building, gardening, and home improvement supplies.
sentences.zh: 这家店通常生意兴隆，源源不断的顾客前来选购建筑、园艺和家居装修用品。

sentences.en: But on that evening, the aisles were near empty, as most people were home in front of the TV,
sentences.zh: 但在那个夜晚，过道里几乎空无一人，因为大多数人都坐在电视机前，

sentences.en: eagerly waiting for the World Series baseball game between the Detroit Tigers and San Diego Padres to begin.
sentences.zh: 急切地等待着底特律老虎队和圣迭戈教士队之间的世界大赛棒球赛开打。

sentences.en: At around 7.30pm, Billy and Ada Deal arrived at Oli's with their two-and-a-half-year-old grandson, Matthew Troidel.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点30分左右，比利和阿达·迪尔带着两岁半的孙子马修·特罗伊德尔来到了奥利家居中心。

sentences.en: They were stopping by the store to pick up a few things, and had promised Matthew they would treat him to an ice cream just as soon as they finished shopping.
sentences.zh: 他们顺路来店里买点东西，并答应马修一买完东西就请他吃冰淇淋。

sentences.en: Upon entering Oli's, Ada placed Matthew into a shopping trolley and began navigating the large store interior.
sentences.zh: 一进奥利店，阿达就把马修放进购物车里，开始在这家大商场内部穿梭。

sentences.en: The shop was divided into multiple departments, lined with aisles of floor-to-ceiling shelving, abundantly stocked with tools, paint, electrical items, homewares,
sentences.zh: 店内划分为多个部门，摆满了直通天花板的货架通道，里面大量备有工具、油漆、电器、家居用品，

sentences.en: and other home hardware merchandise.
sentences.zh: 以及其他家庭五金商品。

sentences.en: Billy Deal gradually separated from his wife and grandson, venturing towards the other side of the store.
sentences.zh: 比利·迪尔渐渐与妻子和孙子分开，独自朝店的另一头走去。

sentences.en: At around 8pm, 18-year-old Oli's employee, Jim Obdom, was nearing the front of the shop, when he noticed a pillar of dark smoke emanating from one of the display racks.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点左右，18岁的奥利店员工吉姆·奥布多姆走到店前部附近时，注意到其中一个展示架上冒起了一柱黑烟。

sentences.en: He didn't notice any flames, but the smoke was quickly growing thicker and darker.
sentences.zh: 他没有看到火焰，但浓烟迅速变得又浓又黑。

sentences.en: Jim rushed down the aisles, alerting customers and advising everyone to make their way outside.
sentences.zh: 吉姆快步冲过过道，提醒顾客并建议所有人赶快到外面去。

sentences.en: The handful of other staff members on shift that evening took Jim's lead, and passed on the evacuation message to anyone lagging behind.
sentences.zh: 当晚值班的其他几名员工效仿吉姆的做法，将疏散消息传达给任何行动迟缓的人。

sentences.en: Billy Deal was on the opposite side of the building to his wife and grandson when he first heard someone yell fire.
sentences.zh: 比利·迪尔第一次听到有人喊失火时，正处在距离妻子和孙子建筑物对面的位置。

sentences.en: He looked across the store and was shocked to see an anonymous cloud of smoke fast approaching.
sentences.zh: 他朝店里望去，震惊地看到一团不知从何而来的浓烟正快速逼近。

sentences.en: Billy couldn't see Ada or young Matthew anywhere, and within moments, the smoke became so thick and dark, that he couldn't see a thing.
sentences.zh: 比利到处都看不到阿达或小马修的身影，转眼间，浓烟变得如此浓重漆黑，以至于他什么也看不见了。

sentences.en: Every time Billy yelled out Ada's name, the smoke filled his lungs, making it difficult for him to breathe.
sentences.zh: 比利每次大喊阿达的名字，浓烟就会涌入他的肺部，让他呼吸困难。

sentences.en: Billy had no choice but to make a break for the exit, and desperately hoped his wife and grandson had already made it safely outside.
sentences.zh: 比利别无选择，只能夺路冲向出口，他拼命祈祷妻子和孙子已经安全逃到了外面。

sentences.en: Across the other side of the store, Oli's employee Jim Obdom passed Ada Deal pushing Matthew in the shopping trolley, and warned her they needed to leave.
sentences.zh: 在店的另一头，奥利店员工吉姆·奥布多姆路过推着购物车里马修的阿达·迪尔，并警告她必须离开。

sentences.en: Jim headed towards the front exit, turning around to check if Ada and Matthew were behind him, when suddenly, the black pillar of smoke transformed into a blazing wall of fire.
sentences.zh: 吉姆朝前门出口走去，转身查看阿达和马修是否跟在后面时，突然间，黑烟柱变成了一堵熊熊燃烧的火墙。

sentences.en: The still doors designed to contain fire within certain departments of the store automatically dropped down from the ceiling,
sentences.zh: 旨在将火势控制在商店特定区域内的防火门自动从天花板落下，

sentences.en: and the electricity cut out, making it impossible to see a thing.
sentences.zh: 电力中断，让人什么也看不见。

sentences.en: When he was standing, panicked, Jim ducked low to the ground, holding his breath and feeling his way along the walls,
sentences.zh: 在惊慌失措站立不稳之际，吉姆俯身贴地，屏住呼吸，摸索着墙壁前行，

sentences.en: until he finally located the fire exit in the back corner of the hardware department.
sentences.zh: 直到他终于找到了五金部后角的紧急安全出口。

sentences.en: He burst outside, desperately gasping for air.
sentences.zh: 他冲到户外，大口大口地喘着粗气。

sentences.en: When the cool night air hit him, Jim felt the full force of what had just happened.
sentences.zh: 当清凉的夜风吹拂在他身上时，吉姆才真切感受到刚刚发生的一切有多么可怕。

sentences.en: His skin blazed raw with second and third degree burns.
sentences.zh: 他的皮肤被二度至三度烧伤，火辣辣地疼。

sentences.en: When he touched his wounded arm, skin fell off.
sentences.zh: 当他触碰受伤的手臂时，皮都掉了下来。

sentences.en: As the fire intensified inside the store, the remaining employees and customers raced towards the emergency exit at the back of the electrical department.
sentences.zh: 随着店内火势加剧，剩下的员工和顾客纷纷冲向电器部后方的紧急出口。

sentences.en: The wave of fire roared behind them at momentous speed.
sentences.zh: 滔天的火浪以惊人的速度在他们身后咆哮。

sentences.en: As they ran, a flashover occurred.
sentences.zh: 在他们奔跑的过程中，发生了轰燃。

sentences.en: Flashovers are widely regarded as one of the most dangerous and dreaded things that can occur during a fire of such magnitude.
sentences.zh: 轰燃被普遍认为是此类规模火灾中可能发生的最危险、最令人恐慌的事情之一。

sentences.en: When certain organic materials are heated to extreme temperatures, they release flammable gases that can cause an entire room to instantly burst into flames.
sentences.zh: 当某些有机材料被加热到极端温度时，它们会释放出易燃气体，导致整个房间瞬间爆燃。

sentences.en: Oli's home centre was only three blocks away from the South Pasadena fire station, so the shopping plaza's surrounding parking lot was quick to fill with fire engines,
sentences.zh: 奥利家居中心距离南帕萨迪纳消防局仅三个街区，因此购物广场周围的停车场很快停满了消防车，

sentences.en: desperately trying to get the blaze under control.
sentences.zh: 它们正竭尽全力控制火势。

sentences.en: As more firefighters arrived to attack the inferno,
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多的消防员赶来扑灭大火，

sentences.en: Billy Deal frantically searched the parking lot for his wife and grandson, hoping they made it out safely.
sentences.zh: 比利·迪尔在停车场里疯狂地寻找他的妻子和孙子，希望他们能安全逃生。

sentences.en: Neighbouring apartment complexes were evacuated, as the billowing smoke filtered inside.
sentences.zh: 滚滚浓烟弥漫进来，邻近的公寓大区被紧急疏散。

sentences.en: A Red Cross shelter was established in the adjacent Pasadena War Memorial Building, where the 100 evacuees were provided with emergency assistance.
sentences.zh: 毗邻的帕萨迪纳战争纪念馆内设立了一个红十字会庇护所，为100名疏散人员提供紧急援助。

sentences.en: In the chaos, it was determined that four people, two Oli's employees, Caroline Krause and Jimmy Satina, and two customers were unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 在一片混乱中，经确认有四人失踪，其中包括两名奥利员工卡罗琳·克劳斯和吉米·萨蒂纳，以及两名顾客。

sentences.en: Billy Deal would soon learn that his wife Ada and grandson Matthew were the two customers missing.
sentences.zh: 比利·迪尔很快就会得知，他的妻子阿达和孙子马修正是那两名失踪的顾客。

sentences.en: The Oli's home centre fire took 125 Los Angeles firefighters until midnight to get it under control.
sentences.zh: 125名洛杉矶消防员直到午夜才将奥利家居中心的大火控制住。

sentences.en: They battled the dangerous conditions, exacerbated when nearly an acre of roofing collapsed, completely obstructing access to the store,
sentences.zh: 他们顶着危险的条件奋战，近一英亩的屋顶坍塌更是雪上加霜，彻底阻断了通往店内的通道，

sentences.en: and eliminating the possibility of entering to save anyone trapped inside.
sentences.zh: 也彻底断绝了进入店内营救任何被困人员的可能。

sentences.en: The fire continued to burn out until the early hours of the morning, leaving nothing but a pile of ash and debris.
sentences.zh: 大火一直燃烧到清晨，现场只剩下一片灰烬和废墟。

sentences.en: California is ranked as the US state most prone to wildfire, with over 2 million households at extreme risk at any time.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州被列为全美最易发生野火的州，随时有超过200万户家庭面临极端风险。

sentences.en: The state has seen some of the most devastating fires in American history.
sentences.zh: 该州经历过美国历史上最具毁灭性的几场大火。

sentences.en: This risk is highest in the state's central and southern regions, where the brush that surrounds the Los Angeles countryside contains tough,
sentences.zh: 这种风险在该州中部和南部地区最高，洛杉矶乡村周边的灌木丛含有坚韧的、

sentences.en: leathery leaves and volatile natural oils that are highly flammable.
sentences.zh: 革质的叶子以及高度易燃的挥发性天然油。

sentences.en: Combine this with the Mediterranean climate, dry landscape, drought-resistant vegetation,
sentences.zh: 再加上地中海气候、干燥的景观、耐旱植被，

sentences.en: as well as the hot and strong Santa Ana winds blowing from the Rocky Mountains and Sierra Nevada desert.
sentences.zh: 以及从落基山脉和内华达山脉沙漠吹来的炎热强劲的圣安娜风。

sentences.en: And you have the perfect recipe for disaster.
sentences.zh: 这就构成了灾难的完美温床。

sentences.en: In order to protect residents and property, hundreds of millions of dollars are spent annually on the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.
sentences.zh: 为了保护居民和财产，加州林业和消防局每年花费数亿美元。

sentences.en: Still, each year, thousands of fires destroy hundreds of thousands of acres, with subsequent damages in the hundreds of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，每年仍有数千场火灾摧毁数十万英亩土地，随之而来的损失高达数亿美元。

sentences.en: Wildfires can spark from a variety of sources, from lightning to power lines.
sentences.zh: 野火的起因多种多样，从闪电到输电线不一而足。

sentences.en: But these accidental causes are only responsible for a very low percentage of fires.
sentences.zh: 但这些意外原因只占极小一部分火灾。

sentences.en: The large majority are generated by people.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数都是人为造成的。

sentences.en: Some result from unattended campfires, erratic burning of debris, or negligently discarded cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 有些源于无人看管的营地火堆、乱烧残渣碎屑，或是随意丢弃未熄灭的烟头。

sentences.en: However, many more turn out to be deliberate acts of arson.
sentences.zh: 然而，更多的情况被证明是蓄意纵火。

sentences.en: Throughout the early 1980s, a wave of wildfires swept through central and southern California, significantly increasing the need for stricter fire control.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代初，一股野火风暴席卷了加利福尼亚州中部和南部，大大增加了对更严格防火控制的需求。

sentences.en: Fires numbered in the thousands, destroying hundreds of thousands of acres, and racking up monumental damage bills.
sentences.zh: 火灾数量达数千起，摧毁了数十万英亩的土地，并造成了天文数字般的损失账单。

sentences.en: Foothill brush fires within the Glendale region in the state's south were widespread, with investigators estimating that at least 80% were deliberately lit.
sentences.zh: 该州南部的格伦代尔地区发生了大面积的山麓灌木丛火灾，调查人员估计其中至少80%是蓄意点燃的。

sentences.en: A majority of the fires took place within the affluent area of Chevy Chase Canyon in the San Rafael Hills,
sentences.zh: 大部分火灾发生在圣拉斐尔山脉富裕的切维蔡斯峡谷地区，

sentences.en: a locale that boasts impressive real estate on significant blocks of land.
sentences.zh: 该地拥有大片土地上令人印象深刻的豪华房产。

sentences.en: Luckily, most burnt out or were contained before any significant damage occurred.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，大多数火灾都在造成重大损失之前自行熄灭或被扑灭。

sentences.en: But the problem was endemic enough for the Glendale Fire Department to realise higher precautions and greater resources were needed.
sentences.zh: 但这个问题已经严重到让格伦代尔消防局意识到，必须采取更高的预防措施并投入更多资源。

sentences.en: At the time, local police handled all arson cases for the city of Glendale.
sentences.zh: 当时，格伦代尔市的所有纵火案都由当地警方处理。

sentences.en: But with this recent spade of deliberately lit fires, the fire department wanted to develop a specialised arson investigation unit and appoint a full-time investigator.
sentences.zh: 但面对最近这起接连发生的蓄意纵火案，消防部门希望建立一个专门的纵火调查股并任命一名全职调查员。

sentences.en: Word got out that the department was looking to hire a dedicated arson investigator who would report directly to the head of the Fire Prevention Bureau.
sentences.zh: 消息传出，该部门正寻觅一名专职纵火调查员，直接向防火局负责人汇报工作。

sentences.en: Despite being a great career move, the position didn't garner much interest amongst firefighters, as it sounded more like police work.
sentences.zh: 尽管这是一个极好的职业发展机会，但这个职位在消防员中并没有引起多大兴趣，因为它听起来更像是警察的工作。

sentences.en: However, there was one applicant in particular who stood out as a desirable candidate for the position, a member of Glendale's Fire Prevention Unit, named John Leonard Orr.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一位求职者尤为引人注目，被视为该职位的理想人选，他就是格伦代尔防火部的成员，名叫约翰·伦纳德·奥尔。

sentences.en: John Orr was a determined and tenacious man who took fire control incredibly seriously.
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥尔是一个坚决且顽强的人，对消防工作极其认真。

sentences.en: After serving in the United States Air Force, his dream was to join the Los Angeles Police Department.
sentences.zh: 在美国空军服役后，他的梦想是加入洛杉矶警察局。

sentences.en: But after failing the entrance exam, he settled for a job as a department store security guard, where he thrived at detecting shoplifters.
sentences.zh: 但在未能通过入学考试后，他退而求其次，在一家百货公司当保安，并在抓小偷方面游刃有余。

sentences.en: Determined to establish a respected career in any area of law enforcement or emergency services,
sentences.zh: 他决心在执法或应急服务的任何领域建立起受人尊敬的职业生涯，

sentences.en: John was accepted into the Glendale Fire Academy in 1974, where he successfully passed the training program to become a full-fledged fireman.
sentences.zh: 约翰于1974年考入格伦代尔消防学院，顺利通过培训项目，成为了一名正式的消防员。

sentences.en: By his early thirties,
sentences.zh: 在他三十出头的时候，

sentences.en: John had made a name for himself with the impassioned and sometimes unconventional approach he took towards catching residents
sentences.zh: 约翰以其充满激情且有时不走寻常路的抓捕方式而名声大噪，他专门抓那些

sentences.en: who recklessly avoided their weed abatement responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 不负责任地逃避杂草清理义务的居民。

sentences.en: He was a rare breed, a firefighter whose real passion seemed to lie with police work.
sentences.zh: 他是一个罕见的人，一个真正的热情似乎在于警察工作的消防员。

sentences.en: During the Glendale Fire Spree,
sentences.zh: 在格伦代尔消防狂潮期间，

sentences.en: John was highly regarded for his dedication to his role within the Fire Prevention Unit.
sentences.zh: 约翰因其对防火部门职责的奉献精神而备受推崇。

sentences.en: Diligent and hardworking, he always made the effort to attend and examine the scene of fires within his jurisdiction, regardless of whether or not he was officially on duty.
sentences.zh: 他勤奋刻苦，无论自己是否正式值班，总是尽力前往并检查自己管辖范围内的火灾现场。

sentences.en: It was at the site of one of the Glendale Hillside fires where John discovered an incendiary delay device made from cigarettes and a matchbook.
sentences.zh: 正是在格伦代尔山坡火灾的现场之一，约翰发现了一个由香烟和火柴盒制成的引燃延迟装置。

sentences.en: An incendiary delay device is a contraption specifically designed to start a fire while leaving enough time for the arsonist to flee the scene.
sentences.zh: 引燃延迟装置是一种专门设计的装置，旨在引发火灾，同时为纵火犯逃离现场留出充足时间。

sentences.en: John's discovery was impressive as the Glendale Fire Department had failed to locate any evidence of arson at the Hillside fires up until that point, earning John a big accolade.
sentences.zh: 约翰的发现令人印象深刻，因为在此之前，格伦代尔消防局未能找到山坡火灾是纵火的任何证据，这为约翰赢得了巨大的赞誉。

sentences.en: When it came time to appoint a full-time arson investigator,
sentences.zh: 当需要任命一名全职纵火调查员时，

sentences.en: John Orr was the obvious choice.
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥尔是不二之选。

sentences.en: John was thrilled with his promotion and took on his new responsibilities with gusto.
sentences.zh: 约翰对自己的晋升欣喜若狂，并以极大的热情投入到新的职责中。

sentences.en: He loved the problem-solving elements that came with investigative work as it made him feel like the policeman he'd always longed to be.
sentences.zh: 他热爱调查工作带来的解决问题元素，这让他觉得自己一直渴望成为的那种警察。

sentences.en: By 1982, an article in the American Fire Journal reported that since the inception of Glendale's arson investigation unit, arson cases in Glendale

sentences.en: Pacific Grove.
sentences.zh: 太平洋格罗夫举行的会议。

sentences.en: John Orr's workplace was in Glendale, a city north of central
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥尔的工作地点在格伦代尔，那是洛杉矶市中心以北的一个城市

sentences.en: Los Angeles, and his family home was situated in the neighbouring suburb of Eagle Rock.
sentences.zh: ，他的家则位于相邻的鹰岩郊区。

sentences.en: Both locations stemmed from highways 101 and 99, the routes Marvin
sentences.zh: 这两个地点都源于101号和99号公路，马文·凯西

sentences.en: Casey concluded the arsonists travelled when hitting the targets within the allocated timeframes.
sentences.zh: 推断纵火犯在规定时间内袭击目标时正是走这些路线。

sentences.en: It was likely John would have driven these highways to and from both conferences.
sentences.zh: 约翰很可能是开车经由这些公路往返于两次会议之间的。

sentences.en: It was also known that he took both trips alone.
sentences.zh: 据了解，这两次行程他都是独自前往。

sentences.en: This revelation was additionally surprising, as John Orr's partial fingerprint on the incendiary device had actually been tested against his employee print sheet back in 1989.
sentences.zh: 这一发现同样令人惊讶，因为早在1989年，约翰·奥尔留在燃烧装置上的部分指纹就已经与他的员工指纹档案进行过比对。

sentences.en: However, the technician failed to make the connection due to limitations in fingerprint technology at the time.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于当时指纹技术的局限性，技术员未能将二者联系起来。

sentences.en: Despite conducting complex analysis, he was limited to using a form of manual testing that involved visually comparing the samples and didn't
sentences.zh: 尽管进行了复杂的分析，他也只能使用一种人工测试方法，即目测比对样本，而没有

sentences.en: notice the similarities between prints.
sentences.zh: 注意到指纹之间的相似之处。

sentences.en: This oversight would later be considered a grave human error.
sentences.zh: 这一疏忽后来被认为是一个严重的失误。

sentences.en: Investigators paused as the full weight of what they were considering sunk in.
sentences.zh: 随着他们所考虑的事情的分量完全沉淀下来，调查员们陷入了沉默。

sentences.en: The incendiary device hadn't been mishandled by John Orr.
sentences.zh: 燃烧装置并不是被约翰·奥尔不小心损坏的。

sentences.en: It belonged to John Orr.
sentences.zh: 它本来就属于约翰·奥尔。

sentences.en: The revelation that the pillow pyro could be a well-respected arson investigator and fire captain
sentences.zh: 这个“枕头纵火犯”竟然是一位备受尊敬的纵火调查员和消防队长，这一发现

sentences.en: was an incredibly sensitive breakthrough, and the task force had to tread extremely carefully to ensure the information remained strictly confidential in case John was innocent.
sentences.zh: 是一个极其敏感的突破，专案组必须极其谨慎行事，以确保信息严格保密，万一约翰是清白的呢。

sentences.en: Those who were privileged to the information were in a deep state of shock at the possibility that the alleged arsonist was John Orr, a man they admired, an esteemed member of the
sentences.zh: 得知这一消息的人们感到震惊万分，因为涉嫌纵火的竟然可能是约翰·奥尔——一个他们敬仰的人，消防界备受尊崇的成员，

sentences.en: firefighting community who dedicated his life to catching firebugs and keeping the community safe.
sentences.zh: 他将一生奉献于抓捕纵火狂和保障社区安全。

sentences.en: Many of them had attended his training seminars and found his insight into the minds and behaviours of pyromaniacs to be invaluable.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人都参加过他的培训研讨会，并发现他对纵火狂心理和行为的见解极其宝贵。

sentences.en: John was widely regarded for his special ability to discover evidence at arson sites that other qualified fire officials were unable to detect.
sentences.zh: 约翰在火灾现场发现其他合格消防官员无法检测到的证据的特殊能力，广受赞誉。

sentences.en: Colleagues reported that John had always been fast at determining the cause of a fire, often locating incendiary devices with ease.
sentences.zh: 同事们报告说，约翰总是能迅速确定火灾原因，常常轻而易举地找到燃烧装置。

sentences.en: When a fire was blazing, John would hastily appear at the scene and was sometimes the first responder.
sentences.zh: 每当发生火灾，约翰总是匆忙赶到现场，有时甚至是最先到达的救援人员。

sentences.en: It also surprised no one to see John present at fires even when he was off duty.
sentences.zh: 看到约翰即使在休班时也出现在火灾现场，大家也都见怪不怪。

sentences.en: Upon reflection, John's unique skills and peculiarities also spotlighted him as someone to view with suspicion.
sentences.zh: 如今回想起来，约翰独特的技能和特质也使他成为了一个值得怀疑的对象。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, without evidence, the task force knew there was every chance speculation against
sentences.zh: 然而，在没有证据的情况下，专案组知道，针对

sentences.en: John Orr could boil down to mere coincidences.
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥尔的种种猜测很有可能只是一场巧合。

sentences.en: For the Pillow Pyro Task Force, identifying their suspect was one thing,
sentences.zh: 对于“枕头纵火犯”专案组来说，确认嫌疑人是一回事，

sentences.en: but putting a full-scale investigation into place and making an arrest was a different challenge altogether.
sentences.zh: 但展开全面调查并实施逮捕则是完全不同的挑战。

sentences.en: Given the severity of the accusations against John Orr, the United States Attorney's Office became involved.
sentences.zh: 鉴于对约翰·奥尔的指控极其严重，美国联邦检察官办公室介入了此案。

sentences.en: They wanted to establish a complete chain of evidence to build the most compelling case possible.
sentences.zh: 他们希望建立一条完整的证据链，以构建尽可能令人信服的案件。

sentences.en: Prosecuting a Californian fire official for committing the very crimes he was hired to prevent
sentences.zh: 起诉一名加州消防官员犯下他被雇来防止的罪行

sentences.en: John Orr was a major criminal case, and they had to ensure the investigation was meticulous.
sentences.zh: ——约翰·奥尔是一起重大的刑事案件，他们必须确保调查一丝不苟。

sentences.en: John's fingerprint on the incendiary device was incriminating, but the Attorney's Office needed a lot more evidence to prove he was absolutely responsible
sentences.zh: 约翰留在燃烧装置上的指纹具有定罪意义，但检察官办公室需要更多证据来证明他绝对要为

sentences.en: for the amount of fires he was being accused of starting.
sentences.zh: 他被指控纵火的数量负责。

sentences.en: The print only linked him to the 1987 Kraft Mart fire in Bakersfield, but the signature MO meant he could have been responsible for a countless number of arson attacks,
sentences.zh: 指纹只能将他与1987年贝克斯菲尔德的卡夫市场火灾联系起来，但其标志性的作案手法意味着他可能应对无数起纵火袭击负责，

sentences.en: including the recent outbreak in Los Angeles, the Central Valley Spree in 1987, and the Central Coast Spree in 1989.
sentences.zh: 包括最近在洛杉矶爆发的火灾、1987年中谷疯狂纵火案以及1989年中海岸疯狂纵火案。

sentences.en: The US Attorney's Office arranged a confidential meeting with John Orr's immediate superior,
sentences.zh: 美国检察官办公室安排与约翰·奥尔的直接上级

sentences.en: Battalion Chief Christopher Gray, to break the news that his prized arson investigator was now the focus of the Pillow Pyro investigation.
sentences.zh: 大队队长克里斯托弗·格雷举行了一场保密会议，向他透露了一个消息：他珍视的纵火调查员现在成为了“枕头纵火犯”调查的核心目标。

sentences.en: The Attorney's Office warned the Chief that there was still a lot of work to be done to build their case, and that an arrest was still quite some time away.
sentences.zh: 检察官办公室警告局长，要建立案件还有大量工作要做，距离实施逮捕还有相当长的一段时间。

sentences.en: While he refused to believe the allegations at first,
sentences.zh: 尽管起初拒绝相信这些指控，

sentences.en: Chief Gray agreed to provide whatever assistance he could, including obtaining call-out sheets and phone records from the Glendale Fire Department.
sentences.zh: 格雷队长还是同意提供他所能提供的任何协助，包括从格伦代尔消防局获取出勤记录和电话记录。

sentences.en: Gray also informed the Attorney's Office that John Orr planned to attend a five-day training course on peace officer safety in San Luis Obispo at the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 格雷还向检察官办公室透露，约翰·奥尔计划于月底前往圣路易斯奥比斯波参加为期五天的执法人员安全培训课程。

sentences.en: This piece of information was of great interest to the Attorney's Office, as the fact that John would be attending a multi-day training course
sentences.zh: 这一信息引起了检察官办公室的极大兴趣，因为约翰将参加为期多天的培训课程这一事实

sentences.en: presented a golden opportunity to help build their case.
sentences.zh: 为协助构建案件提供了一个绝佳的契机。

sentences.en: If history was anything to go by, this was when the Pillow Pyro was most likely to strike.
sentences.zh: 如果以往的历史可以参考的话，这正是“枕头纵火犯”最有可能再次作案的时候。

sentences.en: On the morning of April 28, 1991, the day before the training course was scheduled to begin,
sentences.zh: 1991年4月28日清晨，即培训课程计划开始的前一天，

sentences.en: John Orr drove towards San Luis Obispo, a city roughly midway between Los Angeles and San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥尔驾车驶向圣路易斯奥比斯波，这是一座大致位于洛杉矶和旧金山之间的城市。

sentences.en: He was unaware that a tracking device had been placed underneath his car, or the fact he was being tailed by six surveillance cars,
sentences.zh: 他并不知道自己的车底下被安装了一个追踪器，也没有察觉到自己正被六辆监视车、

sentences.en: a fixed-wing aircraft, and a team of undercover agents.
sentences.zh: 一架固定翼飞机以及一个卧底特工小组尾随。

sentences.en: The surveillance vehicles couldn't keep sight of him for long, as John hit the freeway at breakneck speed.
sentences.zh: 由于约翰以极快的速度冲上高速公路，监视车辆无法长时间保持对他的视线。

sentences.en: Despite his recklessly fast driving,
sentences.zh: 尽管他疯狂地超速驾驶，

sentences.en: John Orr made his way towards his hotel, the tracking device revealing he made no suspicious stops along the way.
sentences.zh: 约翰·奥尔还是径直驶向他的酒店，追踪器显示他在沿途没有作任何可疑的停留。

sentences.en: The following night, an undercover agent followed John into Thrifty's Drugstore in San Luis Obispo and watched as he purchased what appeared to be a pack of cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，一名卧底特工跟着约翰进入了圣路易斯奥比斯波的一家节俭药妆店，并看着他购买了一包看似香烟的东西。

sentences.en: When John left the store, the agent identified himself to the sales clerk and obtained a receipt for John's purchase.
sentences.zh: 当约翰离开商店时，特工向店员表明了身份，并拿到了约翰购买商品的收据。

sentences.en: The receipt confirmed that John had bought two packs of Marlboro Light cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 收据证实，约翰买了两包万宝路淡味香烟。

sentences.en: This was a promising piece of evidence, as the task force knew that John was not a smoker.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很有希望的证据，因为专案组知道约翰并不抽烟。

sentences.en: The task force maintained strong surveillance of John's actions over the following days, convinced they would catch their suspect in the act.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几天里，专案组对约翰的行踪保持了严密的监视，确信他们能当场抓获嫌疑人。

sentences.en: But to their surprise, the rest of the training course went by without incident.
sentences.zh: 但令他们惊讶的是，接下来的培训课程平安无事地度过了。

sentences.en: Yet, undercover agents confirmed that John didn't take a cigarette break at any point during the five-day training course and no cigarette butts were found in his hotel room,
sentences.zh: 然而，卧底特工证实约翰在为期五天的培训课程中没有进行任何抽烟休息，而且在他的酒店房间里也没有发现烟头，

sentences.en: suggesting the Marlboro Lights were still in John's possession.
sentences.zh: 这表明那些万宝路淡味烟仍然在约翰的身上。

sentences.en: The surveillance team was certain John would use the cigarettes to create his signature incendiary delay device to use as he made his way home to Eagle Rock.
sentences.zh: 监视小组确信约翰会用这些香烟制作他标志性的延时纵火装置，以便在开车回鹰岩的路上使用。

sentences.en: Anticipation was high on the final morning of the training seminar.
sentences.zh: 在培训研讨会的最后一天早晨，人们充满了期待。

sentences.en: Then, as John approached his vehicle to attend his last day of training, something caught his attention.
sentences.zh: 随后，当约翰走近他的汽车去参加最后一天培训时，有什么东西引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: A prickling sense of panic overwhelmed the surveillance team as they watched John squat down at the rear of his car to inspect something underneath.
sentences.zh: 当监视小组看到约翰蹲在车尾检查车底的东西时，一阵刺痛的恐慌感涌上心头。

sentences.en: The antenna of the tracking device the surveillance team had attached had become visible and their suspect had spotted it,
sentences.zh: 监视小组安装的追踪器天线已经露了出来，他们的嫌疑人发现了它，

sentences.en: initially furious at themselves for not concealing the device more thoroughly.
sentences.zh: 他们起初为自己没有把设备藏得更严实而感到十分恼火。

sentences.en: The surveillance team's anger quickly turned to astonishment as John Orr seemingly disregarded the discovery.
sentences.zh: 但随着约翰·奥尔似乎对这一发现置之不理，监视小组的愤怒迅速转变成了震惊。

sentences.en: He simply climbed into his car and drove off.
sentences.zh: 他只是钻进车里，开车走了。

sentences.en: Bewildered, the team discreetly followed John to his destination, the San Luis Obispo Police Department.
sentences.zh: 感到困惑的小组悄悄地跟着约翰来到了他的目的地——圣路易斯奥比斯波警察局。

sentences.en: As soon as John left the police station, two members of the Pillow Pyro Task Force entered and identified themselves to the on-duty police lieutenant.
sentences.zh: 约翰刚离开警察局，枕头纵火狂专案组的两名成员就走了进去，并向值班警长表明了身份。

sentences.en: They were relieved to learn that John had misidentified their tracking device, telling the lieutenant he believed a bomb was strapped underneath his car.
sentences.zh: 得知约翰误认了他们的追踪器，并告诉警长他认为车底绑着一枚炸弹时，他们松了一口气。

sentences.en: The lieutenant offered to call the bomb disposal squad to investigate, but John simply asked for directions to the closest explosives disposal range.
sentences.zh: 警长主动提出叫拆弹小组来调查，但约翰只是询问去最近的炸弹处理场的路线。

sentences.en: He explained that as a fireman, he understood these kinds of threats and could take care of it himself.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，作为一名消防员，他懂这些威胁，自己能处理好。

sentences.en: The range was only two miles away, so the task force had to think quick.
sentences.zh: 靶场只有两英里远，所以专案组必须迅速做出反应。

sentences.en: They called the range and spoke to the bomb sergeant on duty, hastily filling him in on their situation and requesting that he play along with John's theory
sentences.zh: 他们打电话给靶场，和值班的拆弹警长通话，匆忙向他说明了情况，并请求他配合约翰的理论——

sentences.en: that their tracking device was indeed a bomb.
sentences.zh: 即他们的追踪器确实是一枚炸弹。

sentences.en: Upon John's arrival, the bomb sergeant removed the tracker and lied about it as requested, saying it was a harmless fake explosive, probably put there by hooligan kids in the area
sentences.zh: 约翰到达后，拆弹警长取下了追踪器，并按要求撒了谎，称这是一个无害的假爆炸物，可能是当地的顽劣儿童为了寻求刺激放在那里的。

sentences.en: for a cheap thrill.
sentences.zh: 为了追求微不足道的刺激。

sentences.en: The sergeant assured John the device couldn't hurt a flyer, but advised he would be happy to send it through to the training institute for confirmation.
sentences.zh: 警长向约翰保证这个装置不会伤到苍蝇，但建议他很乐意把它送到培训机构进行确认。

sentences.en: John agreed, but oddly, before he left the range, he stopped to take a few photos of the device, including a tracking number listed on it
sentences.zh: 约翰同意了，但奇怪的是，在离开靶场之前，他停下来给这个装置拍了几张照片，包括上面列出的追踪号码

sentences.en: which linked back to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and FirearMs.
sentences.zh: 该号码可以追溯到烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局。

sentences.en: This action suggested he didn't buy the lie about the bomb and perhaps suspected it was a tracker all along, adjusting his behaviour accordingly.
sentences.zh: 这一举动表明他并没有买账关于炸弹的谎言，也许一直怀疑这是一个追踪器，并据此调整了自己的行为。

sentences.en: He then returned to his car and attended the final training session as planned.
sentences.zh: 随后他返回车里，按计划参加了最后的培训课程。

sentences.en: Any expectation that John would act had faded by the afternoon as his wife arrived to join him in San Luis Obispo.
sentences.zh: 到了下午，随着他的妻子抵达圣路易斯奥比斯波与他会合，约翰会有所行动的任何期望都已经破灭了。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the task force held surveillance on the holidaying couple over the following two days, but nothing suspicious occurred.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，专案组在随后的两天里对这对度假的夫妇进行了监视，但没有发生任何可疑的事情。

sentences.en: The sting operation reached its disappointing conclusion when John and his wife made an uneventful journey home to Eagle Rock.
sentences.zh: 当约翰和妻子平静地踏上回鹰岩的旅程时，钓鱼执法行动迎来了令人失望的结局。

sentences.en: Having failed to bust John Orr as their serial arsonist, the Pillow Pyro surveillance team went home defeated.
sentences.zh: 由于未能抓获作为连环纵火犯的约翰·奥尔，枕头纵火狂监视小组铩羽而归。

sentences.en: Their efforts had been sabotaged by the misplaced tracker and it seemed likely John was now aware he was being watched.
sentences.zh: 他们的努力因放错地方的追踪器而被破坏，而且约翰现在似乎已经意识到自己正受到监视。

sentences.en: Surveillance continued in Glendale, but John's notoriously dangerous and unpredictable driving habits made him difficult to follow.
sentences.zh: 监视在格兰代尔继续进行，但约翰出了名危险且不可预测的驾驶习惯让他很难被跟踪。

sentences.en: Since the Pillow Pyro task force had been established, there hadn't been a single arson attempt at any retail store within Los Angeles County.
sentences.zh: 自从枕头纵火狂专案组成立以来，洛杉矶县内的任何零售店都没有发生过一起纵火未遂事件。

sentences.en: The task force checked the daily fire reports diligently, hoping to find something they could link their suspect to, but nothing new came through.
sentences.zh: 专案组认真查阅了每日火灾报告，希望能找到能将嫌疑人联系起来的线索，但没有新的情况出现。

sentences.en: At a loss, the task force considered whether they should make an arrest now based on the little evidence they had in the hopes it was enough to build a case
sentences.zh: 在束手无策的情况下，专案组考虑是否应该现在就根据他们掌握的这点证据进行逮捕，希望这些证据足以建立一个案件

sentences.en: for the 1987 retail fires that were started in Fresno,
sentences.zh: 为了弗雷斯诺1987年发生的零售店火灾，

sentences.en: Tulare,
sentences.zh: 图莱里，

sentences.en: As they deliberated over their next step, the task force managed to obtain a recent mugshot of John Orr.
sentences.zh: 正当他们商量下一步行动时，专案组设法得到了约翰·奥尔最近的面部照片。

sentences.en: The Los Angeles Fire Department put out a phony request for members of the Fire Investigators Regional Strike Team, of which John was a member,
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶消防局发布了一项虚假的请求，要求消防调查员区域打击小组成员（约翰就是其中一员）

sentences.en: to have headshots taken for publication purposes.
sentences.zh: 拍摄用于出版目的的头部照片。

sentences.en: John happily posed for the camera.
sentences.zh: 约翰高兴地对着镜头摆姿势。
